cohort: The study included 432 infants <=32 weeks' gestation admitted to a level-IV single center neonatal intensive care unit from 2014 to 2016, excluding those with major congenital anomalies, death, or transfer before 28 days.
finding: Pre-eclampsia was not a significant risk factor for the development or severity of BPD in infants <=32 weeks' gestation.
mod_finding: Infants born to preeclamptic mothers were delivered by cesarean section more often (88% vs. 60%; P<0.0001) compared to infants born to non-preeclamptic mothers.
birth_weight: Median for pre-eclamptic group: 1265g (IQR 910-1555g); Median for non-pre-eclamptic group: 1388g (IQR 959-1752g)
